facts.text: `keyEffect` in `.pi/lib/tern/keys.ts` maps one complete terminal sequence using pi-tui `parseKey` and `decodeKittyPrintable`, so Kitty CSI-u printable keys are not read byte-by-byte as Escape.

`TaskBrowserView` in `extensions/task-browser/extension.ts` is a task overlay with hierarchical rows (`rows()`), status and blocked filters (`matched()`), a search query, and a detail mode; `BrowserTask` carries `questions` and `answers`.

Tern's task header in `.pi/lib/tern/bridge.ts` (`#taskTop`) renders the focused task's acceptance question rows directly unless collapsed, while the full task list is in a hover popover per the comment above it.

`ask_user_question` is added to the model tool surface when `remoteAsk` is set in `swarmSurfaceFor` (`.pi/lib/runtime/swarm-tool-gating.ts`), and the Tern renderer `.pi/lib/tern/ask-dialog.ts` drives remote-ask events on the Pi event bus.

`validateMermaid` in `.pi/lib/context/mermaid-response.ts` loads the `mermaid` package, which is a `package.json` dependency (^11.12.3) and checked by `RUNTIME_DEPS` in `tools/install/doctor.mjs`; browser globals are installed only during the import and restored afterward, and a failed load logs an error and returns no parser.

The Tern bridge keeps the last live tool-output snapshot in `.pi/lib/tern/bridge.ts` when a cancelled tool has no final payload, and treats it as the full ordered terminal output over the final envelope.
